name: Nanni Galli
features: dark hair, strong Bolognese features, moustache, sturdy build
bio: Autodelta's all-rounder from Bologna: touring cars, the T33/2 and then the 33/3, with a Formula One seat at March and Ferrari on the side. Won the 2-litre class at the Nurburgring and Imola in the Alfa and was the driver Carlo Chiti trusted with a new car.
